external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us

external_entities.name: own device
external_entities.description: A colleague's own device used from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies colleague group membership changes to the broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: A franchise's identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not identify which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, maintains colleague and group information, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to decide whether the holder may change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the broker for tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership is supplied from the HR system overnight; it is not maintained there by hand.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: A token containing the colleague's staff id and groups

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.data_description: A token containing the colleague's staff id and groups

data_flows.name: fetch key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.notes: The source describes applications fetching the public half from the broker; the store admin console is one of those applications.

data_flows.name: provide public key
data_flows.description: The identity broker provides the public half of the signing key for token signature checking.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the signing key

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads the signing key from the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group information in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: franchise sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
data_flows.notes: The text says the franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues, but does not specify the complete sign-in interaction.

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: It is unknown whether the log covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: The environment of colleagues' own devices when they sign in from home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise environment admitted to the sign-in system.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds the broker's signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory holds colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's contents are confidential because it holds sign-ins associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the audit log contains sign-ins.
